name: Elon Musk
role: Businessman (Tesla, SpaceX, X); led the Department of Government Efficiency (2025)
summary: A self-described free-speech absolutist with libertarian leanings who backs smaller government, opposes unions and wealth taxes, and favors nuclear power and a carbon tax. He has moved toward right-wing populism on immigration and culture while supporting universal basic income, estate taxes and pronatalism.
